title: Logical Recipes by Lopachondo
body:
Datapack that adds recipes that just make sense.

- Any wool can be broken down to x4 string
- Netherwart Block can be broken down to x9 warts
- Amethyst blocks can be broken down to x4 amethyst shards
- Craftable Crying obsidian 
- Craftable Nametags

I hope you find this recipes useful.

Not needed but if you'd like to support me check out my link :)
